execution.activation: node420 maintained patch adds p256Verify to Cancun and Prague precompile sets
execution.genesis_rule: Cancun is active at genesis; Prague remains deferred

wiring: deploy P256WebAuthnVerifier420 with the backend address
owner calls SmartAccount420.setPasskeyVerifier with the WebAuthn verifier address
owner enrolls a credential only after wallet and chain qualification

activation_gates: node420 release gate proves P-256 exists at 0x0100 under Cancun rules
Solidity adapter accepts only exact 32-byte return value 1
P256WebAuthnVerifier420 and SmartAccount420 passkey integration tests pass
wallet constructs canonical PK42 envelopes from WebAuthn assertions
runtime features.passkeys remains false until the full end-to-end gate passes
notes: 0x0100 is a protocol precompile, not a genesis alloc.code predeploy.
No code.length check is valid for the native precompile address.
The P-256 patch intentionally moves only the existing upstream verifier forward; it does not activate Prague or Osaka generally.
